annual_rate.notes: Connecticut does not set one automatic percentage for every judgment. Section 37-3a permits up to 10% as damages for qualifying detention of money and caps hospital-service debt at 5%, with awards discretionary. For covered negligence causes arising on or after May 27, 1997, §37-3b requires 10% from the earlier of 20 days after judgment or 90 days after verdict, subject to plaintiff-motion and appeal tolling. Section 37-3c uses a separate Treasury-linked condemnation formula. Verify the applicable branch; not legal advice.
